WHAT IS ICLOUD CLEANER?

iCloud Cleaner is a native macOS app that helps you stop paying for iCloud storage. It scans your iCloud Drive, Desktop, and Documents to find what's eating your space — node_modules, .git folders, old archives, caches, and large files you forgot about.




The app auto-scans on launch and shows you exactly what can be safely deleted. With Smart Clean, you can free up gigabytes of storage with a single click. It then guides you through downloading your photos locally, disabling iCloud sync, and downgrading to the free 5 GB plan.




Built from a real cleanup session that went from 199.89 GB to 2.6 GB of iCloud usage. Signed and notarized by Apple. One-time purchase, no subscription.
